ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

   B. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Names of Scriptures able to:.

11. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)

   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
